name: notify_user
description: Send the user a brief completion summary or request for attention. They can open your conversation for details. Keep full answers in the conversation.

message.description: One short plain-text line, at most 120 characters.

name: agent_catalog
description: List connected providers and available models and reasoning efforts. Select a provider to inspect its catalog.

name: agent_spawn
description: Create a persistent child conversation with a task. Provider is required unless a profile is given. A profile supplies saved settings, behaviors and its provider; explicit arguments override it, and it cannot grant more access than you have. station assigns a free station in your project to the child. Returns the child's ID, checkout path and branch before its work finishes; results and attention requests arrive automatically. The child shares your checkout unless useWorktree is set. Never repeat creation after an unknown outcome; inspect existing children first.

provider.description: Defaults to the profile's provider; a different provider than the profile's is rejected.

title.description: Short title for the child's work, shown under its name. A new worktree's branch is named from it.

useWorktree.description: Create a separate managed checkout of the project primary repository. Omit or false to share the parent’s exact current checkout.

baseRef.description: Optional Git starting ref for a new worktree. Omit to start from your current commit; requires useWorktree.

profile.description: Name of a saved agent profile. Project, checkout, permissions and communication still come from you.

station.description: ID of a free station from agent_stations. Unknown or occupied stations are rejected.

name: agent_message
description: Send another agent a follow-up attributed to you when coordination is authorized. Auto steers a busy agent when supported and otherwise queues; queue waits for the current turn. Accepted queued delivery must not be resent. Include the full message and a short user-visible summary. Communication permissions are enforced. An uncertain reply is not permission to resend; inspect delivery state first.

summary.description: One plain-text line for the user, at most 120 characters. Summarize the request or reply; omit names and private details.

name: agent_read
description: Read a conversation’s latest output, pending attention, children and message delivery state. Omit agentId to inspect yourself and your communication permission. A completed turn does not prove the task succeeded; inspect its result. Questions and approvals remain with the user; inspection grants no approval.

name: agent_wait
description: Wait for one of the selected agents to finish or need attention, then return snapshots. Child results also arrive automatically; prefer doing independent work instead of polling. Timeout returns current state and does not stop agents.

name: agent_stop
description: Stop the selected agent’s work. Its children continue independently. Conversation and results are preserved. This grants no approval.

name: agent_stations
description: List your project's stations: ID, label and occupant.

name: agent_archive
description: Archive one of your own children: removes its body, archives its conversation and frees its station. Its checkout, branch and files are kept. Fails while the child has active work or pending requests. Never repeat after an unknown outcome; inspect existing children first.
